message_source_quote: The task's papers folder contains **Raman et al.'s white-bear steering paper (2026-10-06) — this exact task** (same model, family, readout), which reaches 0.83 pass@10 with a think/don't-think *stance* contrast at layers 20–24.
writeup_source_quote: Raman et al. (white-bear steering) showed that a contrast of two prompt conditions, added to the forward pass, can change what the plain readout surfaces on exactly this benchmark, with two properties that shaped this work

The message adds two extra, source-related details not in the write-up: Raman et al.'s reported 0.83 pass@10 score, and an explicit framing that the task rules forbade reproducing Raman et al.'s method, which is why a new construction was sought.
